title: Riemannian Attention Mechanisms for Transformers: A Theoretical Framework and Architecture Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.01283v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: All Transformer-based large language models compute attention via the Euclidean inner product, an architectural choice that Dong et al. (2021) proved causes representational rank to decay doubly exponentially with depth in pure self-attention stacks. We develop a theoretical framework that targets this structural limitation at the mathematical level by replacing the flat Euclidean metric with learned per-token Riemannian metrics. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We prove that Riemannian attention scores with heterogeneous per-token metrics are non-Gram---they cannot be factorized as QK^T with factorization dimension O(d). We are explicit that this is a structural observation, not a proof of rank preservation. translated_title: 基于黎曼度量的Transformer注意力机制：理论框架与架构设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01283v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：所有基于Transformer的大型语言模型通过欧几里得内积计算注意力，这一架构选择被Dong等人（2021）证明在纯自注意力堆栈中会导致表示秩随深度呈双指数衰减。我们开发了一个理论框架，在数学层面针对这一结构限制，将平坦的欧几里得度量替换为学习的逐词元黎曼度量。我们的贡献有三点：（1）我们证明具有异质逐词元度量的黎曼注意力分数是非格拉姆矩阵——它们不能以因子化维度O(d)分解为QK^T形式。我们明确指出这是一个结构观察，而非秩保持的证明。（2）我们确定低秩度量因子使所有几何运算变得可行：测地距离每词元复杂度为O(d*r)，度量求逆通过伍德伯里恒等式复杂度为O(d*r^2)——两者均远低于完整度量处理的O(d^3)成本。
tldr: 本文提出用逐词元黎曼度量替代欧几里得内积，从数学上克服Transformer自注意力中表示秩的双指数衰减问题，并证明低秩因子化使几何运算高效可行。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes replacing the Euclidean inner product with per-token Riemannian metrics to mathematically overcome the double exponential rank decay in Transformer self-attention, and shows that low-rank factorization makes geometric operations tractable.
